verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Ledgy's API authentication, cap table, equity plan automation, financial reporting, compliance, and trading/settlement features, but contains no mention of board consent drafting, stockholder approval workflows, e-signature routing for governance resolutions, or archiving approvals against transactions. Equity grant signing (ledgy-docs-10, ledgy-docs-12) refers to grant contracts, not board/stockholder consents.
